title: Rams star predicts ‘chaos’ at SoFi Stadium as Aaron Donald prepares for long-awaited return

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams star predicts ‘chaos’ at SoFi Stadium as Aaron Donald prepares for long-awaited return
sources.description: Aaron Donald plans to make his Rams return against the Giants on Monday Night Football, and his teammates expect SoFi Stadium to erupt.
